title: Prescribed Bottom-Head Lower Face Distance Resolution

failure_evidence.head: bbf4399976167d60b6df1fa43c8fc48671b754f9
failure_evidence.failure: HeadCalc mode 5 evaluates grid_disnod(NN+1), while the F-SI14 admitted request geometry carried node_distance(1:NN). Bounds checking therefore failed at parameter_set%node_distance(NN+1).

source_bound_interpretation.fsi14_contract: F-SI14 intentionally qualified node_distance shape active_nodes for admitted modes 7/-2 and explicitly did not add an artificial NN+1 requirement because modes needing the lower face distance were not admitted.
source_bound_interpretation.fsi16_change_in_physical_requirement: SWBOTB=5 computes the lower hydraulic gradient using the distance between the last node and prescribed lower boundary, so NN+1 node-distance geometry becomes physically required.

minimal_resolution.generic_parameter_shape: accept node_distance size active_nodes or active_nodes+1

reasoning: Conditional NN+1 support preserves every already-qualified F-SI14 request while supplying the explicit lower-face geometry that prescribed-head physics actually consumes. Falling back to MOD_grid%disnod(NN+1) would reintroduce a silent legacy geometry authority and is rejected.
